sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.3 "FLASH option key register (FLASH_OPTKEYR)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 175.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be protected against unprivileged access when PRIV = 1
inFLASH_PRIVCFGR.This register is write-only.
The following values must be programmed consecutively to unlock FLASH_OPTCR. A
wrong sequence locks FLASH_OPTCR until next system reset.
1st key = 0x0819 2A3B
2nd key = 0x4C5D 6E7F
Bits 31:0 OPTKEY[31:0]: FLASH option-byte control access unlock key

fields.name: OPTKEY[31:0]
fields.description: FLASH option-byte control access unlock key
